column1: # S199's drift series: the engine now against the pinned early-S105 commit
# f548ff4 (2026-08-20), one fixed 1000-pair match at the harness's own regime
# per block boundary. Appended by adocs/data/S199_drift.py, read by its
# --check; the run is adocs/data/S199_drift.sh and the reading rule is in
# NOT A VERDICT, and not a verdict on any one change inside the interval a row
# covers: a fixed match gives a sum and per-patch attribution is what it cannot
# give (DEC-143, DEC-108). Two rows are comparable only when `ref` and `regime`
# agree; `regime` is tc/hash/book read off the run's own banner.
# elo_95 and nelo_95 are fastchess's printed 95 % half-widths; ptnml is the
# pentanomial from 0 to 2 in the candidate's points; pair_var is the population
# variance of the pair score, computed from the PGN by S105_pairs. The last two
# columns are filled by hand: the step ids whose verdicts landed since the
# previous point, and the ids whose conversions landed since it (F30, DEC-170).
